lines.label: B1
lines.reason: A real formed fold of about 25 deg between the rounded plate (patch 1) and the middle panel (patch 5). In the perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the line sits on the outer-skin apex: the nearest points are 0.44, 0.02 and 0.24 mm away, the outer skin is at about 0 mm along the bisector and the inner skin at +5.7 mm. The line is parallel to the fold. Seen face-on along the bisector, it spans t = 0 to 99.3 mm, exactly between the side edges of the middle panel, so it covers the whole fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: A real formed fold of about 65 deg with a large radius, between the middle panel (patch 5) and the slotted plate (patch 4). In the sections at 25/50/75% the dot sits on the bottom of the outer arc: the nearest points are 0.32, 0.08 and 0.06 mm away, the outer skin is at about 0 mm and the inner skin at +5.5 mm. The line is parallel to the fold and spans t = 0 to 99 mm, matching the panel width between the relief corners. The lines tool reported apex_offset 2.95 mm, but that is distance from the sharp corner of the two fitted planes, not from the surface; the label is on the surface apex.
